changes.evidence: In Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (flashback), the Ta Lo elders refuse to let Wenwu in, so Jiang Li (Ying Li) leaves Ta Lo, gives up her guardian powers and moves to the Ten Rings compound to marry him (and has him disband the Ten Rings). She quits the village; she is not part of any group after.

Episode 2: fired by the DA's office, hired by GLK&H (already recorded). Episode 9 ('Whose Show Is This?'): released from DODC custody, Jen is fired from GLK&H and moves in with her parents (a real departure, not recorded); after K.E.V.I.N. rewrites the ending she regains her job (rejoins GLK&H) in the same episode. End state is unchanged; only the missing fired/rehired pair is added.

Episode 8 ('Follow Me My Friend'): in the Green Witch trial Jen learns Agatha bound her powers, unbinds herself, vanishes from the Road and wakes outside Westview, then flies off alone. She is done with the coven and the coven ends (Lilia dead in ep 7, Agatha dies later in ep 8). Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki lists the coven as 'formerly'. (The wiki still lists Kale Kare as current, but nothing on screen returns her to it, so Independent per the rules.)

At the end of The Marvels (with Monica stranded in another universe, the trio is split), Kamala goes to Kate Bishop's apartment, says she is putting together a team of young heroes and recruits Kate, who agrees. The app already puts Kate Bishop in Young Avengers from The Marvels on this scene; Kamala, who forms the team, has no stage for it.

owner_calls.question: Zemo's only stage is EKO Scorpion from Captain America: Civil War, but in Civil War he is already the former commander (F.R.I.D.A.Y.: 'Zemo ran EKO Scorpion'), acting alone for revenge after Sokovia, and in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier he is a prisoner/fugitive with no unit. No on-screen departure exists. Keep EKO Scorpion as backstory, or make him Independent?
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki lists Sokovian Armed Forces and EKO Scorpion as 'formerly'. After the Battle of Sokovia he became a lone criminal mastermind.
